grading_contract.binary_rule: Correct only when every required condition passes and no forbidden condition is selected; otherwise Incorrect.
grading_contract.tolerance: numeric targets use stated inclusive tolerance; categorical actions require an allowed ID.

challenges.title: Oil Shock and Inflation
challenges.scenario: An imported-energy price jump passes through to transport and food costs.
wrong_types: treats oil shock as demand expansion only
uses reserve release above stock limit
challenges.model_chain: oil cost -> short-run aggregate supply left -> CPI; targeted relief limits real-income loss; tightening moderates second-round demand.
challenges.explanation: A mixed response is required because the shock is supply-side and household exposure differs.

challenges.title: Recession with High Public Debt
challenges.scenario: Weak demand coincides with high debt and rising refinancing cost.
challenges.model_chain: targeted fiscal impulse -> demand -> growth; primary balance and r-g determine debt path.
challenges.explanation: A demand response must be paired with a credible debt arithmetic path.

challenges.title: Minimum Wage in a Concentrated Labour Market
challenges.scenario: One dominant employer pays below marginal revenue product.
wrong_types: uses perfectly competitive labour demand as sole model
challenges.model_chain: upward-sloping firm labour supply -> marginal expenditure above wage -> moderate floor can raise wage and employment.
challenges.explanation: The sign of employment response is conditional on market structure.

challenges.title: Currency Depreciation and Trade Balance
challenges.scenario: A depreciation raises local-currency import prices before export volumes adjust.
challenges.model_chain: depreciation -> import-value rise -> delayed volume adjustment -> ML condition determines medium-run improvement.
challenges.explanation: Elasticities sum to 1.4, so improvement is possible after contract and quantity lags, not guaranteed immediately.

challenges.title: Housing Rent Control
challenges.scenario: Rents surge in a supply-constrained city.
wrong_types: sets cap far below clearing rent without shortage mitigation
challenges.model_chain: binding cap -> excess demand and quality/supply response; voucher raises affordability; supply expands clearing quantity.
challenges.explanation: The benchmark accepts a moderate cap-plus-relief or supply-led path, not a sharp cap alone.

challenges.title: Restaurant Inventory and Food Waste
challenges.scenario: A restaurant orders perishable food under stochastic demand.
wrong_types: uses price rather than contribution margin for underage cost
challenges.model_chain: critical fractile Cu/(Cu+Co) -> demand quantile -> expected waste/profit.
challenges.explanation: The accepted band allows rounding and forecast error tolerance.

challenges.title: Carbon Emissions Policy
challenges.scenario: Industrial emissions must fall while energy affordability remains material.
wrong_types: double counts tax and cap on same emissions
challenges.model_chain: marginal damage/abatement -> price or cap -> abatement; recycled revenue cushions incidence.
challenges.explanation: One primary instrument plus transparent recycling is required.

challenges.title: Bank Run
challenges.scenario: Rumours prompt deposits withdrawals from a solvent but illiquid bank.
wrong_types: treats insolvency and illiquidity as identical
uses support after run has fully settled
challenges.model_chain: coordination expectations -> withdrawals -> liquidity gap -> collateralized lender-of-last-resort support.
challenges.explanation: Support is acceptable only after solvency and collateral gates.

challenges.title: Flexible Work and Wellbeing
challenges.scenario: A service employer considers two flexible-work pilots and must evaluate evidence without claiming unsupported causality.

all: states OLS association is not causal without stronger design

wrong_types: forces all staff to remote work
challenges.model_chain: observed wellbeing = worker effect + time shock + flexible-work exposure + error; FE removes time-invariant worker confounding.
challenges.explanation: A limited pilot and a qualified inference are the correct result.

challenges.title: Trade War
challenges.scenario: A trading partner raises tariffs on metal exports; retaliation risks input inflation.
wrong_types: assumes tariff paid by foreign producer only
challenges.model_chain: tariff wedge -> demand/import response -> export diversion and input-cost feedback.
challenges.explanation: Diversification and finance support dominate broad retaliation under this calibration.

validation: binary grading never uses an undisclosed real-world fact
